cand.title: ASM27 — Ontario Dental Association Annual Spring Meeting
cand.excerpt: Strong organized hospitality-demand mechanism and confirmed Toronto date; venue commitment reduces current-edition accessibility.
cand.ledgerVenue: Metro Toronto Convention Centre, South Building

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Helen McDowell, Director, Conference & Events, is the most relevant first organizational contact for lodging/sourcing referral; her published remit is sponsorship and advertising, so hotel contract control is unverified. Teresa Tomassetti, Specialist, Conference, handles speakers/registration and ASM27 alumni-reunion inquiries, making her relevant for speaker and small-group pathways. Cynthia MacDonald, Specialist, Exhibits, is relevant for exhibitor relationship introductions. None is verified as the hotel contracting signatory.
findings.futureEdition: ASM27 is officially announced for May 6–8, 2027 in Toronto at Metro Toronto Convention Centre, South Building. These are activity dates, not publication dates. The May 6–7 Emerging Speaker Showcase is only a subset of the three-day meeting. The homepage also announces May 11–13, 2028; it does not explicitly assign a city or venue to that edition. The May 6, 2027 ODA 160th-anniversary celebration is announced for 5:30–10 p.m., with further details due January 2027.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using supplied hotel specifications: a downtown convention-adjacent city hotel is appropriate; resort substitution is not supported. The 157 guestrooms cannot house the whole convention, whose historical attendance exceeds 11,000. A modest delegate/exhibitor block, self-paying speaker stays, VIP lodging or a small reunion is plausible, not verified demand. A 15–109-peak-room discussion is a hotel-side prospecting range, NOT event-published demand or a forecast. Meeting proposals must stay within the supplied 240-theatre/224-banquet largest-room limits; restaurant/lounge and catering availability require hotel confirmation. Historical ASM25 reporting specifically lists this hotel, strengthening a relationship-recovery lead without proving prior production.
findings.venueCommitments: Officially published ASM27 venue: Metro Toronto Convention Centre, South Building, entrance 222 Bremner Boulevard, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. This is Toronto proper/downtown within the supplied MTCC territory, not an out-of-town resort or competing host hotel. Public venue confirmation is verified; a signed contract and hotel commitments are not publicly established.
findings.historicalRotation: Documented recent editions are Toronto-based: ASM23 May 11–13, 2023; ASM24 April 18–20, 2024 at MTCC South; ASM25 May 8–10, 2025 at MTCC South; ASM26 May 7–9, 2026 at MTCC South. This establishes recent recurrence, not a destination-rotation schedule or a guaranteed Toronto venue for 2028.
findings.accommodationSourcing: ASM27 housing bureau, host hotel, hotel blocks, contracting agent and open RFP remain unverified. The official hotels URL could not be retrieved; silence is not evidence of open sourcing or closure. Historical ASM26 official notice: “Hotel room blocks for ASM26 are open” and “We've worked with a selection of hotels to provide you with preferred rates”. This proves an ODA-arranged preferred-rate pathway for 2026 only, not 2027 availability. For ASM25, Dental Tribune reports: “the ODA has arranged special hotel accommodations at discounted rates.” Every hotel named there is Fairmont Royal York; Novotel Toronto Centre; Le Germain Hotel Toronto Mercer; Hyatt Regency Toronto; Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown. No named ASM26 or ASM27 hotel list was verified. These ASM25 names are historical participation evidence, not current contracts, pickup or inventory.
findings.organizationStructure: The Ontario Dental Association is a voluntary professional association representing Ontario dentists and owns the ASM as its signature event. Its named internal Conference & Events staff provide organizer pathways. MTCC is the venue, not the event owner or a verified housing buyer. Canadian Dental Association participation is specifically announced for the 2027 anniversary celebration; it does not establish housing control. No external PCO, DMC or housing bureau was verified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: ASM27 meeting venue is already announced at MTCC, so do not pitch relocation of the main convention. Historical ASM25 preferred-rate alternatives were Fairmont Royal York, Novotel Toronto Centre, Le Germain Hotel Toronto Mercer and Hyatt Regency Toronto alongside Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown. Their 2027 incumbent status is unknown. ASM26 promotional language said preferred-rate rooms sell out quickly, but this is not verified actual overflow, sold-out inventory or unmet demand. No 2027 overflow, room-night total or peak-room requirement was found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Helen McDowell first, reference the historically published ASM25 Radisson participation and ask whether ASM27 hotel selection is complete, who contracts lodging, whether the hotel already has a block, and whether incremental blocks or referrals are permitted. Review internal ASM25/ASM26 contracts and actual pickup before quoting. Ask Teresa Tomassetti about reunion organizers and self-paying speaker accommodation pathways; use Cynthia MacDonald only for exhibitor introductions. Offer a modest rooms-first proposal subject to availability, rates and confirmed terms; do not promise catering. If ASM27 is closed, obtain the ASM28 sourcing timetable and confirm its city before pursuing.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For ASM27, main-event venue access is constrained by the published MTCC commitment; accommodation access is unconfirmed, not proven closed and not proven open. The prior likely_closed_incumbent label is not established for lodging by the retrieved evidence. Emerging Speaker Showcase participants explicitly pay their own accommodation, so these stays are not automatically an ODA-funded speaker block. Alumni/class reunion submissions provide a real inquiry pathway, not a confirmed hotel event.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: prioritize repeat preferred-rate participation or reactivation, rather than convention relocation. ASM28 dates May 11–13, 2028 are official and within the horizon, but Toronto/city/venue and housing timing remain unresolved. If Toronto is confirmed, seek the hotel-selection calendar and a right-sized block or independent group referral. No open future RFP or displacement window is verified.
